sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 256x192, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 40 mK; optical: 1/5in CMOS 2688x1520

storage.notes: NAS (NFS, SMB/CIFS) with ANR; no onboard microSD

operating_temp_c: -40 to 70 C (accurate temperature measurement -20 to 60 C)
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum thermography cube camera
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/5in progressive scan CMOS
thermal detector: uncooled VOx FPA, 256x192, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 40 mK (2.1 mm F1.0, FOV 90 horizontal)
temperature measurement -20 to 550 C, accuracy Max (+/-2 C, +/-2%) with point/area/line rules
temperature exception alarm for fire prevention with built-in buzzer
white light supplement up to 3.5 m and white-light visual alarm
Modbus TCP support for third-party integration
bi-spectrum image fusion and picture-in-picture display, 17 color palettes

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical channel 1 (101) and thermal channel 2 (201) are exposed separately.

release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD3028T-2 is a bi-spectrum thermography cube camera combining a 256x192 uncooled VOx thermal module (2.1 mm lens) with a 4 MP optical channel, measuring object temperature from -20 to 550 C at Max (+/-2 C, +/-2%) accuracy for fire prevention in electrical and industrial applications. Verified against the official HIKMICRO datasheet.
